criteria.name: Programming fundamentals
criteria.description: Applies basic data structures, control flow, and language fundamentals to backend tasks.

criteria.name: API and HTTP fundamentals
criteria.description: Understands request and response behavior, common HTTP methods and status codes, and basic API design.

criteria.name: Data modeling and databases
criteria.description: Can reason about data shape, persistence, and straightforward database queries or tradeoffs.

criteria.name: Problem solving and debugging
criteria.description: Breaks down unfamiliar problems, investigates failures methodically, and explains a reasonable solution.

criteria.name: Testing and code quality
criteria.description: Recognizes useful test cases and writes or describes clear, maintainable code.

criteria.name: Security and reliability basics
criteria.description: Shows awareness of input validation, error handling, and common backend security or reliability concerns.

criteria.name: Communication and learning
criteria.description: Communicates assumptions and reasoning clearly, responds constructively to feedback, and demonstrates curiosity.
